title.text: Material QEMU Deploy Assistant: one-click VirtualBox, VMware, Docker and USB hosting (Intel and AMD)

n1.text: Deploy wizard. Pick VirtualBox, VMware or Docker on this computer (only detected, running ones are enabled, with the reason otherwise). VMs take the latest verified OVA or a local file; Docker takes the release image, a LAN address and a port. Language (English, Cantonese, both) and Animations sit in the side bar. Try clicking the cards.

n2.text: Deploying. Real phases from the app: download, SHA-256 check, import, configure, start, wait for the appliance serial report, health check. Toggle the Ready tweak to see the success screen with the LAN link. The first account created there becomes the owner, so no setup code is shown.

n3.text: A failed deployment takes over the screen and stays until dismissed. It shows the exact failing command, exit code and the last real output lines, plus recovery actions. Values here are illustrative only.

n4.text: Instance manager. Lists only instances this app created: hypervisor, version, health and link, with start, stop, restart, open, copy link and remove. Health is checked live, never assumed. Click a row's Stop/Start to try it.

n5.text: Remove super confirmation. Names the exact instance and what is deleted. Turn both keys to unlock the full-range slider; it pulses while moving and plays a separate completion animation at 100%. Emergency exit and Esc cancel and return focus to the Remove button. Try turning the keys and sliding.

n6.text: Flash. Writes the PC (x86_64) image to a removable USB disk for a spare Intel or AMD PC (Raspberry Pi is out of scope); the system disk is never listed and nothing is preselected. Disks over 512 GB get a backup-drive warning. Two keys unlock the slider; Windows then asks for administrator approval, and the written disk is read back and checked against the release hash.
